ig:
अंधेरे से डर | Scared of the Dark — Bedtime Story for Kids in Hindi & English 🌙
गोलू को अंधेरे से डर लगा… दोस्तों ने कहा: डरना ठीक है! टॉर्च से देखा — अरे, ये तो बनी के कान! 🐰🔦
Golu is scared of the dark. His friends say it's okay to be scared, they look together with a torch — it's only Bunny's ears! Night light on, teddy hug: "मैं बहादुर हूँ — I am brave!" 🧸⭐

Play it at bedtime for your little one. डर लगे? बताओ, रोशनी करो! — Scared? Tell someone, turn on a light!
Know a parent of a toddler who is scared of the dark? Send this to them 📩
